name: Venera-13
about: Venera-13 (1981-106A, IKI/BABTS), launched 1981 Oct 30. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); GCAT gives no heliocentric orbit to check it against (solved: perihelion 0.703 au, aphelion 0.994 au)
GCAT gives no heliocentric orbit for this phase
